Hotel Suiren, Hasuike Onsen

Unwind in the glow of the baths.

CUISINE

The season, course by course

Mountain vegetables and seafood from nearby waters, the day's best, composed dish by dish. Mornings bring a Japanese breakfast with clay-pot rice at our dining room, Suiren.

Dinner
Seasonal kaiseki, ¥7,700 per person (tax included). After booking your stay, please request it by 17:00 the day before arrival. Plans on the booking page are room only or with breakfast.
Where dinner is served
In private rooms at our dining room, Suiren. Meals are not served in guest rooms.
Breakfast
¥1,500 per person. A Japanese breakfast with clay-pot rice at Suiren.
Food allergies
We can accommodate seven allergens: egg, milk, wheat, shrimp, crab, buckwheat and peanut. Please note them in the requests field when booking.

ROOMS

Rooms for quiet hours

Twenty rooms in all: tatami rooms that open onto the garden veranda, and calm single rooms for the solo traveler. Every room is designed around unhurried time.

Japanese-style room30 m² · sleeps 4¥10,000〜¥24,000 / person / night
Twin room22 m² · sleeps 2¥12,000〜¥18,000 / person / night
Single room14 m² · sleeps 1¥12,000 / person / night
Bedding
Futon in Japanese-style rooms; beds in twin and single rooms.
In-room baths
Rooms do not have private open-air baths. Please enjoy the grand baths, open-air baths and our private bath.
Rates
Per person per night (room only), depending on how many guests share the room. Japanese-style room: ¥10,000 each for 4 guests, ¥12,000 for 3, ¥15,000 for 2, ¥24,000 for 1. Twin room: ¥12,000 each for 2 guests, ¥18,000 for 1. Single room: ¥12,000. Breakfast adds ¥1,500 per person per night. Rates include tax and service charge; a bathing tax of ¥150 per person per night is charged separately.

ONSEN

The Jade Bath

A soft, jade-green hot spring fills the baths. Stars above the steam at night; morning light through the trees at dawn. (A fictional hot spring.)

Spring type
Sodium chloride spring (a fictional hot spring)
Free-flowing
Pure free-flowing hot spring water, with no added water, heating or recirculation.
Grand and open-air baths
Separate for men and women. 15:00–24:00 and 6:00–9:00
Private bath “Hasu”
40 minutes for ¥2,200, 15:00–22:00. Please reserve at check-in.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Is the hot spring free-flowing? What type of spring is it?
Yes. It is free-flowing, with no added water, heating or recirculation. The spring type is sodium chloride (a fictional hot spring).
Are there rooms with a private open-air bath?
No. Please use the gender-separated grand baths and open-air baths, or our private bath, Hasu.
Is there a private bath?
Yes, one private bath, Hasu: 40 minutes for ¥2,200, available 15:00–22:00. Please reserve at check-in.
Can I stay with dinner? Is it served in the room?
Dinner is seasonal kaiseki at ¥7,700 per person (tax included). After booking, request it by 17:00 the day before. It is served in private rooms at our dining room, Suiren, not in guest rooms.
Can you accommodate food allergies?
We handle seven allergens: egg, milk, wheat, shrimp, crab, buckwheat and peanut. Please note them in the requests field when booking.
What are the rates for children? Can they share a bed?
Children of elementary school age and under can share a bed for free (no meals or futon). Children's breakfast is ¥800.
When do cancellation fees apply?
50% of the room rate the day before, and 100% on the day.
Is there a shuttle from the station?
Yes, a free shuttle from Hasuike Station between 15:00 and 18:00. Please reserve by the day before. The drive takes about 10 minutes.
Until what time can I check in?
Check-in is 15:00–22:00. Please contact us if you will arrive after 22:00.
How can I pay?
Pay at the property by cash or credit card. Rates include tax and service charge; the bathing tax of ¥150 per person per night is extra.
